The '''Cone Hat''' is a [[Hats|hat]] that can be purchased from the [[Night Market#Magic Shop Boat|Magic Shop Boat]] at the [[Night Market]].  Each year, its purchase price on Winter 15 is {{Price|5000}}, on Winter 16 is {{Price|2500}}, and on Winter 17 is {{Price|10000}}.
